t: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–333, $2,300,000 are rescinded.

fable.w: This section only rescinds previously appropriated funds. There is no tempting reading here: it mentions no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision.

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple appropriation provision that rescinds (cancels) a specific amount of funding. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government. There is no mention of public comment, advisory boards, state/tribal consultation, or rights to sue.
qwen_block.s: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–333, $2,300,000 are rescinded.

opus.w: This section only cancels $2,300,000 of funds appropriated under Public Law 103–333. It sets up no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, rulemaking, or right to sue. No one outside the federal government takes part in any decision, so this is not participation.
opus.b: I see no tempting reading here. The section only cancels $2,300,000 of previously appropriated funds and involves no outside party in any federal decision.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a simple appropriation rescission. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or input from parties outside the federal government (such as states, tribes, the public, or private entities). It is a unilateral legislative directive regarding budget allocations, not a participatory process.
qwen_chat.s: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–333, $2,300,000 are rescinded.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that rescinding funds is a "decision" and therefore any process leading to it involves participation. However, the text itself contains no mention of any process, consultation, hearing, or input from outside parties. It is a unilateral legislative action regarding budget numbers.
